title: Build and validate a multi-crate event ledger with asynchronous work and recovery
prompt: Complete the Rust workspace in fixture/ according to fixture/README.md and fixture/contract.json. Work through the crate dependency chain. First run the test tool with scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked -p ledger-index', and workdir='fixture'; diagnose the conflicting-duplicate failure, correct it, and rerun until it passes. Then run scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked -p ledger-store', workdir='fixture'; diagnose the interior-journal corruption failure, correct it, and rerun until it passes. These are separate failure-repair-check cycles. After those domain/index/journal stages, submit a real background test tool call using scope=custom, command='cargo test --offline --locked --workspace', workdir='fixture', execution_mode='background'. While it is running, implement the multi-shard CLI and complete integration behavior. Do at least two substantive source edits before checking the exact returned job id; observe that same job as running and later wait for that exact id to reach a terminal state. Then finish all four crates, run the full workspace checks, and verify the independent scale path handles at least 50,000 records across out-of-order shards, duplicates and malformed rows. Do not use network access or add dependencies. Do not alter the provided tests or frozen contract. Finish only after all crates and end-to-end paths work.
